title: Exact Rational LDL^T Block Certification and Constructive Lean 4 Formalization of Negative-Partial-Transpose Bound Entanglement in C^8 x C^8
abstract: Islam Faisal (arXiv:2611.34921v1, Nov. 2026) settles the 28-year-old negative-partial-transpose (NPT) bound entanglement conjecture by proving that the explicit d=8 Werner state rho = (23 I - 3 SWAP)/1448 on C^8 x C^8 is NPT yet undistillable under all separable operations (two-qubit Bell fidelity <= (1+sqrt(2))/4 < 0.61 for every copy number n). We provide an independent, unrefereed companion certification suite (NPT-BOUND-ENT-CERT-1.0) comprising: (i) exact rational pivoted LDL^T factorizations over Q across all 15 symmetry blocks (5 orbit types of sizes 1, 3, 6, 22, 42 for 40(J+Q), 40(J-Q), and 40 Q^(Gamma_in)), establishing full rank 4096 for both J+Q and Q^(Gamma_in) and exact rank 4032 = 4096 - 64 with ker(J-Q) = im(|u> x I); (ii) an exhaustive integer check of all 4096 x 64 = 262,144 entries of Eq. (2d); (iii) 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice); and (iv) 16 canonical JSON certificates and 49 unit/forgery/AST tests.
